question:

solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59a4e2f9c74e11768bea4efd5696492e3c9735a069a581ad0d0ca82722cb5d01.png]

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68d8e450c8028b5798bbd60d72882bbb728ddee86deca83b00395b916b3aab07.png] The combination is inverted.
